settings.headline: Starting with us
settings.subtitle: First visits are booked Tuesday and Wednesday mornings and are longer so we can review your records and set a plan.

settings.headline: Before your first visit
settings.intro: Call the front desk to begin. There is no sign-up form on this site.

items.title: Send records
items.text: Ask your last doctor to send records, or bring a copy.

items.title: Gather
items.text: Photo ID, insurance card, medicines and questions.

settings.headline: Patient area
settings.body: After your first visit, the front desk creates your patient-area account. You then see visit summaries, lab results and prep sheets after signing in. In this demo, sample patient and staff accounts exist only to show the pattern.
settings.label: Call the front desk to confirm your plan. The list on this demo site is fictional.
